pattern.name: Riverbank ripples
pattern.description: Broad broken horizontal water rings wrap the empty edges, paired with one low-relief leaf vein. Uneven gaps and elliptical curves suggest a quiet riverbank without drawing a scene.

background.status: Selected presentation for the owner-authorized framing repair. Background is independent of the animal and existing website theme.

framing.note: Uniform 88% bottom-aligned placement; the head and accessories retain their exact relative proportions. A narrow source-colored continuation of the existing shoulder restores the left frame entry exposed by the inset. Protect expressive features separately from intentional lower shoulder intersections.

continuation.description: Minor outer shoulder/wing continuation behind the uniformly inset approved source; only the narrow newly exposed side strip is restored. Flat source-sampled facets, no repeated edge pixels or neck stretching. All opaque placed source pixels are verified unchanged by the finisher.

matte.calibrationNote: Native background sampled at [251,252,252] or [251,251,251]. Pass 01 revealed separate pale residue only on the native top border (maximum component 63 pixels), unrelated to anatomy. A broader near-white chroma window and a 128-pixel isolated-component threshold clear that residue. All four animals and retained accessories are connected; enclosed eyes remain protected.
